result.brief: 提出 W-JEPA：用小波多尺度 token 网格与 EMA 目标编码器的联合嵌入潜空间预测，学习可跨数据集迁移的可穿戴惯性信号表征。
result.reason: JEPA-style self-supervised latent prediction with EMA target encoder and multiscale wavelet tokenization; representation learning contribution, though applied to wearable inertial signals rather than vision/video.
